_comment: Bad Genius (2017). PASS 3 TRANCHE 1 - NOT COMPLETE. Every shot here was seen in frames; none came from the Wikipedia plot or the machine-translated transcript. Each action text ends with a verification token: [dense 0.75s] = read from a --zoom burst across the whole window; [grid 5s] = seen only in the 5s overview grid, which is acceptable ONLY for long held shots where the grid gives 3+ frames inside the window and the framing does not change. MEASURED: 74% of this film's shots are shorter than the 5s grid step (median shot 3.0s), so [grid 5s] is NOT sufficient inside any set-piece. Set-piece phases still needing a dense burst are listed in beats_proposal.md and are deliberately absent here rather than guessed.

shots.action: FRAME STORY / HOOK: Lynn in profile at a long table, her own reflection repeating away down a mirrored wall until it is a queue of her [grid 2s, re-verified: 01:22 through 01:34, seven frames, one held setup - stood exactly as catalogued at 5s]

A sealed clear bag of small dark objects is already lying on the table when we arrive; she is shown looking at it, and only then does a hand slide it across to her [grid 2s, re-verified: 01:36/01:38 the bag alone, 01:40/01:42 her face, 01:44/01:46 the hand pushing it, 01:48/01:50 her answering. CORRECTED: the 5s pass called the contents 'pencils and erasers' - they are not resolvable at 2s or 0.75s - and had the push before the look, which is the wrong way round]

Her record is opened on the desk in front of her: the file cover in her legal name, a school certificate, and a press clipping headlined 'The new Crossword Champion' with her photograph on it [grid 2s, re-verified: 02:28 the cover, 02:30/02:32 the certificate, 02:46/02:48 the clipping. CORRECTED: the 5s pass put this at 02:55, where the file has already been closed and two administrators are talking instead]

120,000 is written into the air beside her head and stays there while the fee is explained - the first of a running series of sums that keep accumulating over this scene, reaching a circled 150,000 by 04:18 [grid 2s, re-verified: 03:36 through 03:50 with the figure held in frame. CORRECTED: attributed to 'the director' at 5s; there are two administrators in the room and they take it in turns]

It is a school photo call - a red backdrop, a camera on a tripod, a queue of shoes. Grace takes the new girl in hand in front of it: talks at her, fixes her hair, and lifts the glasses off her face before the shutter [grid 2s, re-verified: 05:20/05:22 the red wall, 05:24-05:30 Grace talking, 05:32 the hair, 05:40 the glasses coming off, 05:42/05:44 the photographer. CORRECTED: the 5s pass had the red wall as a wall and missed the photo session entirely, which is the whole reason the grooming is happening]

INSERT: a pink worksheet, question 1, a Venn diagram and four multiple-choice sets - then the two of them head to head over it, Grace animated and nowhere near the answer [grid 2s, re-verified: 07:40/07:42 the sheet, 07:44 through 07:58 the two-shot. CORRECTED: the 5s pass placed them 'on the library floor'; the floor-sitting wide is at 07:16-07:26, before this shot starts]

Interview insert: Lynn front-on in the dark room, still, answering - the film cuts here to introduce the first thing she did [dense 0.75s: 08:50-09:00, single unbroken framing, no cut inside the window]
Title card 'สอบกลางภาค' (midterm) burns in over a wide of the exam room from the back - rows of white shirts, one supervisor [dense 0.75s: 09:00-09:04, card present on every frame]
Grace at her desk with her hand at her temple, looking at a paper she cannot do and then around the room for help (face readable at 09:08-09:09) [dense 0.75s: 09:05-09:09]

INSERT, hands only: the wrapper is peeled off a red 'Plastic br.111' eraser and the answers - Thai letters ก ข ค ง - are written along the inside of it against the answer sheet [dense 0.75s: 11:33-11:37, four separate inserts, no face in frame]
Grace waiting, hand still at her temple, eyes going sideways to the desk behind her [dense 0.75s: 11:38-11:40, face readable]

Down at floor level under the desks - white socks, black school shoes, and one foot already easing out of one of them [grid 2s: 12:00 the shoes, 12:02 Lynn's face, 12:04 the floor, 12:08 Grace straining, 12:10/12:12 the shoes again]

The relay: a shoe goes across the classroom floor from foot to foot, pushed a desk at a time, with the answers folded inside it [grid 2s: 12:38/12:40 the girls above, 12:42 through 12:50 the shoe travelling under the desks, 12:52 it arriving]
It gets there. Two heads go down over the same desk and the supervisor at the front never looks up [grid 2s: 12:54/12:56/12:58 the girls, 13:00 the room, 13:02/13:04 the front of the class]

A different world entirely: a bathrobe embroidered PATTON HOTEL BANGKOK, and a rooftop pool lit turquoise against the city at night [grid 2s: 14:26 the robe, 14:28/14:30 someone going in off the side, 14:32/14:34 the pool]

Pat holds court from the water with Grace and Lynn in it beside him, and there is champagne on ice at the edge of the pool [grid 2s: 14:36 through 14:46 the three of them, 14:48 the bucket and glasses, 14:50 through 14:54 the pool wide]
Pat gets the red-backdrop portrait too, and then a receipt: 10,875.48 [grid 2s: 14:56/14:58 the red, 15:00 the receipt, 15:02/15:04 the monochrome frame]

Lynn sits on the poolside in a hotel robe with her arms round her knees while Pat talks up at her from the water, a bottle in his hand - the whole offer happens with him below her and her not answering [grid 2s: 15:16 through 15:34, ten frames, the two of them across the edge of the pool]

Home at night, at her father's desk, going through his papers - and an official receipt with a school seal on it and a figure in the corner [grid 2s: 18:00 the wide, 18:02 through 18:08 the receipt held to the lamp, 18:10/18:12 her small in the room]
There is more than one. She works down through a folder of them, and stops at a framed photograph of a woman holding a baby [grid 2s: 18:14 through 18:28 the documents, 18:30 the photograph]
She reads the last of it with her hand over her mouth [grid 2s: 18:32/18:34/18:36/18:38, the same close]
She sits down at the upright in the corner of the living room and puts both hands on the keys [grid 2s: 18:40/18:42 the hands on the keyboard, 18:44/18:46 her at it, 18:48 her face]

Her father comes to the doorway in a vest and stands there listening, and neither of them says anything about the receipts [grid 2s: 18:50 through 19:04 the two of them across the room, 19:06/19:08 the wide with the piano and him leaving, 19:10 her still sitting at it]

INSERT after INSERT of four fingers going down on the keys while the clients sit on the sofa behind her and watch her do it - the method is taught as a piano exercise before it is ever an exam [grid 2s: 21:38/21:40 the keys, 21:44/21:46 the sofa, 21:48 the keys again]

Lynn at the upright in a red shirt, turned half round to explain it, the backs of their heads across the bottom of frame [grid 2s: 21:50/21:52 her, 21:54/21:56/22:00 her hands, 21:58 the wide, 22:02/22:04/22:06 her over their shoulders]

The living room: five of them on and around the sofa working out that she is serious, and Lynn still at the keyboard waiting for them to catch up [grid 2s: 22:08/22:10/22:12 the sofa, 22:14/22:16/22:18 her at the piano]

The exam room instead: Lynn with her chin on her hand looking down the rows, a wall clock and a Thai flag, and the cover sheet - end of term 2/2557, 8.30 to 10.30 [grid 2s: 22:20/22:22 her, 22:24 the clock, 22:26 the paper]

The desk and the piano cut into each other - her writing, the keys, her hand tapping on her own knee, a client smiling two rows over, bubble 20 going down [grid 2s: 22:28/22:30/22:32 the room, 22:34 the keys, 22:36 the knee, 22:38 the client, 22:40 the bubble]
A recital stage under red curtains, a small figure at the front holding a bouquet, cut in without explanation [grid 2s: 22:42/22:44 the stage, 22:46 back to hands on a desk]
A black BMW comes up to the school gate and a man gets out of it drinking - the kind of money that is buying this [grid 2s: 22:50 the grille, 22:52 the car, 22:54 him getting out]
Two boys at their desks reading her hands off the far side of the room and putting the letters straight down [grid 2s: 22:58 one looking across, 23:00/23:02/23:04 both writing, 23:06 the bubbles]

INSERT: a handwritten ledger, names down one column and sums down the other - 1,500, 3,000, 12,000, 19,000, 24,000 - the service has a price list [grid 2s: 23:12 a hand and a watch, 23:14 the page, 23:16/23:18 a client's room]

A gift box with a keyboard printed on it, and the girls with their heads together at the desks afterwards, laughing behind their hands [grid 2s: 23:38/23:40 the box, 23:42/23:44/23:46 the whispering, 23:48 Lynn's face]

A posed group photograph of four of them, then the school's own banner across the front of the building congratulating its students on the 2557 results [grid 2s: 23:50 the photo, 23:52 the building, 23:54/23:56/23:58 the banner]
The same red photo backdrop Lynn was put in front of, and this time it is Bank sitting on the stool - then the frame drains to black and white [grid 2s: 24:02/24:04 the red, 24:06 the monochrome]
Head down at a desk writing, and an INSERT of a hand holding out a name label - BANK [grid 2s: 24:14 him writing, 24:16 the label, 24:18 the washroom door]
What the scholarship actually costs him: he is alone in the school washroom after hours, wiping down the basins [grid 2s: 24:18/24:20/24:22 the same wide, him working the length of the row]
Bank's turn at the interview table - the same black surround, the same glass of water, front-on and unmoving [grid 2s: 24:40/24:42/24:44, one held frame]
Both of them being lit and photographed for the school, in profile, one after the other [grid 2s: 26:26 through 26:42, nine frames alternating him and her under the lamps]
Teen Genius: the school's two best students side by side behind a quiz desk on a blue studio set, buzzers in front of them [grid 2s: 26:44 through 26:52 the two-shot, 26:54 the host]
The director's office, and the director already sitting behind the desk waiting for them [grid 2s: 26:56/26:58/27:00]

The two of them stood side by side in front of her desk while the overseas scholarship is explained - one place, two candidates, and neither of them looks at the other [grid 2s: 27:02 through 27:26, thirteen frames, the same standing two-shot with the director in reverse]
Bank leaves first, without waiting [grid 2s: 27:28/27:30 him going out, 27:32/27:34 the director still talking]

Home is a laundry. Earphones in, hands in someone else's washing, a schoolbook and a phone propped on the bench beside him [grid 2s: 28:48 him, 28:50/28:52 the hands, 28:54 the book, 28:56/28:58 the phone on the book]
He works the press on his own into the night, crouched at the machine, the room lit by one red indicator [grid 2s: 29:00 through 29:14, eight frames, the same wide]
Cut to Lynn at the interview table talking about him, in a long unbroken close-up [grid 2s: 29:16 through 29:36, eleven frames, one held shot]

Corridor before the exam: Pat and a classmate in glasses, the classmate doing all the grinning and all the talking, Pat mostly listening [dense 0.75s at 00:30:10: the two-shot reverses cleanly every second or so; the classmate is a recurring buyer and is not named anywhere in frame]
The hall before anyone is in it - desks in ranks the length of a sports floor, each with its own lamp [grid 2s: 30:50/30:52/30:54 the same high wide]
The same hall full, shot from the back: several hundred candidates and one invigilator alone at a table at the far end [grid 2s: 31:36 the rows, 31:38 the full wide, 31:40/31:42 back to the desks]
INSERT: a name and a class going onto the header of an answer sheet in ballpoint [grid 2s: 31:44/31:46 the form, 31:48/31:50 the room settling]
Time compressed by superimposition - candidates dissolving through each other over the rows, then the wall clock [grid 2s: 31:52/31:56/31:58 the dissolves, 32:00 the clock]

THE TWO PAPERS: a wristwatch laid on the desk, a question sheet, then the insert that breaks the scheme - 'ข้อสอบของนักเรียนเป็นข้อสอบชุดที่ 1 / ก. ชุดที่ 1 / ข. ชุดที่ 2', question 40 asking which of two different papers you were given [dense 0.75s: 32:00-32:07, the Q40 insert holds from 32:04 to 32:07]
Bank stops writing, looks up and around the hall, works something out, and puts his hand up for the supervisor [dense 0.75s: 32:08-32:15, he is in frame throughout, hand raised at 32:12]
The supervisor at his desk under a green banker's lamp, seen past the shoulders of two students - the only authority in a hall of hundreds [dense 0.75s: 32:16-32:19]
Lynn reads question 40 twice and stops moving; behind her the room keeps working [grid 2s: 32:22 her face, 32:24 the desks, 32:26 an invigilator, 32:28/32:30 a candidate turning a page]

INSERT: 'A. Set 1' on the paper, and the pencil filling that bubble - the hall has been split into two exams sitting side by side [grid 2s: 32:32 the line, 32:36 bubble 40 under the pencil, 32:34/32:38/32:40 candidates checking their own]

The invigilator in glasses has stopped patrolling and is watching one part of the room; a candidate half-raises a question and thinks better of it [grid 2s: 32:42/32:44/32:46 him watching, 32:48/32:50/32:52 the candidate]

A hand with a steel watch runs a straightedge down a completed answer sheet and then writes across a blank page in Thai [grid 2s: 33:12 the hand, 33:18/33:20/33:22 the sheet under the edge, 33:24/33:26 the writing]

Lynn works with her head down and her eyes going sideways across the rows; the classmate in glasses answers the look [grid 2s: 36:06/36:10 her looking off, 36:08 him, 36:14/36:18 her back on the paper]
Both hands flat on the paper, an eraser turned over, the clock, and the pencil going down the bubbles [grid 2s: 36:20 the flat hands, 36:22 the eraser, 36:24 the clock, 36:30 the sheet under the nib]
Writing at speed - a watch strap, a fist round the pencil, then a full page of dense working held up [grid 2s: 36:44/36:46 the hands, 36:48 the bubble sheet, 36:52 the covered page]

The method itself: her hands worked over the desk edge like a keyboard, a small eraser turned between the fingers as she goes [grid 2s: 37:16/37:20/37:22 the fingering, 37:24 her hands and a neighbour's in the same frame]

INSERT: 40 filled for A on one paper, 'B. Set 2' printed on another, and between them a hand laid flat and still on a desk - one signal, two exams [grid 2s: 37:30 bubble A, 37:40 the flat hand, 37:42 the Set 2 line, 37:44 the hand again]

Lynn's face coming up, and a second hand with a black watch laid flat on a desk further down the row - it is moving through the room now [grid 2s: 37:56 her face, 38:00 the watch hand, 38:08/38:10 her again, 38:12 the hand]
Time is called and the invigilators start down the rows collecting [grid 2s: 38:38 him calling it, 38:42 the collection from the back, 38:44 a candidate looking up]

A grey-haired senior invigilator stops and says something quiet to one candidate, and Lynn watches the whole of it without moving [grid 2s: 38:46/38:48/38:50 him talking, 38:52/38:54/38:56 her watching, 38:58 the classmate in glasses]
The classmate in glasses gets both fists in the air over his own desk before he is out of the room [grid 2s: 39:00 him bent over, 39:02 the punch, 39:04 him sitting back down]

A girl a few desks over sits back with her hands over her mouth, laughing, while the papers are still being taken in [grid 2s: 39:06/39:08/39:10 her; too small at this grid scale to identify her against names.json, so left unnamed]
INSERT: the thread, read by 20, timestamped 8:03 - then two of them sitting on the school steps sharing one screen [grid 2s: 39:24/39:26 the chat, 39:28/39:30 the steps]
The morning after: Lynn and Grace on the school steps with a phone between them, counting it up [grid 2s: 39:36/39:38/39:40/39:42, the same group on the steps]
Bank comes out through a doorway behind them holding a folded sheet of paper, and keeps walking [grid 2s: 39:44/39:46 him in the doorway, 39:48/39:50 the girls turning to watch him go]
Lynn stands up. She watches him all the way down the corridor and neither of them says anything [grid 2s: 39:52 through 40:00 her standing and watching, 40:02/40:04 the office door closing]

The office: the director behind her desk, Lynn and a classmate in front of it, and Bank sitting off to one side having already said his piece [grid 2s: 40:06 through 40:22, nine frames, the room from several angles]
INSERT: the paper spread out on the desk - sheets of handwriting, laid down one beside another [grid 2s: 40:24 the pages in a hand, 40:26 them going down on the desk, 40:28 Lynn's face above them]
Lynn watches the director read it and does not say a word in her own defence [grid 2s: 40:30 through 40:36 her face, 40:38 through 40:44 the director reading, 40:46 the room]

Her father is in the room now, in a checked shirt and glasses, and Lynn stands against the window blinds where she does not have to look at him [grid 2s: 42:08/42:10 him, 42:12 through 42:20 her in profile against the blinds]
Bank says it again with her father sitting there, pointing at the desk as he does it [grid 2s: 42:22 through 42:32, six frames, him talking and gesturing]
The director delivers it and Lynn's father takes it sitting down, without arguing [grid 2s: 42:34 through 42:40 her talking, 42:42 through 42:50 him listening]
He tries anyway - leaning in over the desk - and the answer comes back with her hands folded on the blotter [grid 2s: 44:28 through 44:34 him, 44:38/44:40/44:42 her, hands folded, unmoved]

The wide has all three of them standing in a row in front of the desk - Lynn, her father, and Bank at the end of it looking at the floor - and then Lynn finally speaks [grid 2s: 44:52 through 44:58 the row, 45:00 through 45:10 held on Lynn talking]

Out at the door afterwards, the two of them end up side by side for a second, and neither one of them has anything to say to the other [grid 2s: 45:28 the doorway, 45:30/45:32/45:34 the two-shot, his eyes down, hers not]

Home, at the round table by the window: her father stands the whole time, leaning on the back of a chair over a cup he never picks up, and does not raise his voice; Lynn sits in her uniform and takes it [grid 2s, re-verified: 46:16 through 46:42, fourteen frames, he never once sits down - stood exactly as catalogued at 5s]
Grace's turn at the interview table, and she is the only one of them who cries doing it [grid 2s: 48:22 a hand on the table, 48:24 through 48:38, eight frames held on her face]

A ring-pull going back on a cold can, and Lynn drinking it - the film's one clean breath before the second half starts [grid 2s: 48:40/48:42 the can opening, 48:44/48:46 her drinking, 48:48 her laughing]

A restaurant with panelled walls and waiters: Grace in a yellow T-shirt across the table from Lynn, plates arriving over their shoulders [grid 2s: 48:50 through 49:10, eleven frames, the two of them and the service going on around them]

The other end of the table: an older couple doing the talking and the laughing, a hand sliding a folder across the cloth to her, and Lynn listening with a wine glass between her and them [grid 2s: 51:36 the woman, 51:40 the folder crossing the table, 51:42/51:44 the couple, 51:46/51:48 Lynn, 51:50 the paper on the cloth]
Lynn does the asking for once - leaning in across the table while Grace sits back and lets her [grid 2s: 51:52 through 52:16, thirteen frames, shot and reverse across the table]
INSERT: a book put down on the tablecloth - a STIC preparation manual [grid 2s: 52:18 the cover, 52:20/52:22 Grace looking at it, 52:24 Lynn]
She keeps talking and it is the first time in twenty minutes of film that she looks interested in anything [grid 2s: 52:26 through 52:46, eleven frames]
A hotel counter, and someone holding a phone up to her with a photograph on it [grid 2s: 54:00 through 54:04 her at the desk, 54:06 through 54:12 the phone held out, the same held frame]
She stops mid-sentence and looks up at something above and behind the desk [grid 2s: 54:14 through 54:26, seven frames, her face tilting up and staying there]

What she is looking at: a wall of clocks, each with a brass plate under it - NEW YORK, then LONDON, then DUBAI, then BANGKOK, all showing different times [grid 2s: 54:28/54:30 NEW YORK alone, 54:38 NEW YORK and LONDON, 54:40 LONDON, 54:42 DUBAI, 54:44 BANGKOK]
Held on her face while she does the arithmetic [grid 2s: 54:46 her looking up, 54:48/54:50 the wide with her small under the row, 54:52 through 54:56 the close]

The last clock on the wall says SYDNEY, and it is hours ahead of every other one - that gap is the entire plan [grid 2s: 54:58/55:00 the SYDNEY clock, 55:02 through 55:06 her face, 55:08/55:10 her standing under the whole row]

INSERT: a hand pushes a small red pin-flag into a world map, and it goes into AUSTRALIA [grid 2s: 55:12/55:14 the hand and the pin, 55:16 the flag standing in it, 55:24 the flag again with the whole Pacific beside it]

The print shop with the map open on the table: Grace and Pat leaning over it while Lynn stands over them both and lays the thing out [grid 2s: 55:26 through 55:52, fourteen frames, her standing and the two of them seated]
They start asking questions back, and she has an answer for each of them [grid 2s: 55:54 through 56:22, fifteen frames, shot and reverse across the map]
A wet street at night, headlights, a scooter pulling away - the last ordinary shot before the assault [dense 0.75s: 57:45-57:46]

Bank sets a laundry basket down at a lit gate to work the padlock; two unlit figures are already standing in the foreground of the frame, and he has not seen them [dense 0.75s: 57:47-57:52, the figures are present in every frame]

He is taken at the gate - dragged down out of the light, the attackers in silhouette, the basket going over. No face and no injury detail in frame [dense 0.75s: 57:53-58:04]. CENSOR none per S7 'dark/silhouette violence, already obscured by lighting' - frame-checked, not assumed

Security-camera footage, black and white, timecoded 19:53:25: two figures cross a gateway, a car is parked across the frame, and by 19:53:31 there is a body on the ground beside it [grid 2s: 58:16 through 58:26, six frames, the timecode advancing six seconds]
Daylight, and a close-up of what it cost: one eye swollen shut, dried blood across his face [grid 2s: 58:28 the close, 58:30/58:32/58:34 him lying in the rubbish]
The wide pulls out and he is a white shirt in the middle of a landfill, a tyre beside him, the tip going up the frame behind [grid 2s: 58:36 through 58:44, five frames, the same enormous wide]
He gets himself upright out of it - sits, looks around at where he is, and starts working out how to walk off a rubbish tip in a school uniform [grid 2s: 00:00 through 00:14, eight frames]
A school lobby with a brass-railed staircase and a red presentation board propped at the bottom of it [grid 2s: 00:20/00:22 students filing past, 00:24/00:26 the board]
A darkened hall, one silhouette against a lit screen, and the screen says STIC [grid 2s: 00:28/00:30 the silhouette, 00:32/00:34 him lit against the logo]
The room he is selling to: rows of students in school uniform, in the dark, listening [grid 2s: 00:40/00:42/00:44 the audience]

INSERT: an ordinary pencil turned in the light, and the barcode printed down the length of it - 4 902778 999042 [grid 2s: 01:28/01:30 the pencil close, 01:32/01:34 the barcode blown up on the projection screen]

Pat works the front of the hall like a product launch, mic in hand, walking the length of the screen [dense 0.75s at 01:01:54: face clearly resolved and matches the Bangkok print-shop scenes; grid 2s: 01:36/01:38/01:40/01:42 him working the length of the lit screen]
INSERT: the screen resolves the bars into four groups and labels them A, B, C, D - the code is the answer key [grid 2s: 01:44 the screen, 01:46 the letters under the bars]

Four pencils go up the screen, one under another, each with a different barcode - one pencil per answer set, and a red callout ringing the last of them [dense 0.75s at 01:01:54; grid 2s: 01:52 one pencil, 01:54/01:56 four, 02:00/02:02 the callout]

Back at the print shop the two of them lean over a map with small coloured markers on it, working out where in the world this has to happen [grid 2s: 02:10/02:12/02:14 the map and the markers, 02:16/02:18 the two of them]

The laundry, shot from the street through the shop's own signage: she has come to him, and he keeps working the press while she talks [grid 2s: 03:38 through 03:58, eleven frames, the orange sign across the foreground the whole time]
Inside, among the shelves of folded and bagged laundry, she makes the offer [grid 2s: 04:10 through 04:16 her at the shelves, 04:18/04:20 him at the ironing station, 04:22 through 04:26 her again]
He does not move from the board. The answer takes a while and she has to stand there for all of it [grid 2s: 04:28 through 04:36 him, 04:38 through 04:46 her waiting]

The print shop as a war room: she comes through the door in silhouette, he is already sitting there, and the place is empty except for the presses [grid 2s: 06:04 the silhouette, 06:08/06:10 Bank at a table, 06:12 her face, 06:14 through 06:18 the SAFETY FIRST beam and the floor]

All four of them in one room for the first time: Pat in the patterned shirt doing the talking, Bank in navy not moving, Grace and Lynn on either side of the machine [grid 2s: 06:20/06:22 Pat and Grace, 06:24 through 06:30 Pat and Bank facing off, 06:32 Grace, 06:34 Bank]

INSERT: the plan is a web form. STIC Registration - personal info, test centre - and then the admission ticket itself, with her photograph, October 8 2016, and the test centre printed as University of Sydney [grid 2s: 06:50 the form, 06:54 the fields, 06:56 the ticket, 06:58 a hand on a marker]
Money moving in the background of it - a car, an older woman sitting down with her, and a Teen Genius graphic open on a monitor [grid 2s: 07:04 the car, 07:06/07:08 the two of them, 07:10 the screen]

The night before: Lynn mid-sentence at the press, Pat and Grace hanging off each other laughing, Bank sitting apart looking at the floor - and then the bag, open, full of banknotes [grid 2s: 09:36 Lynn, 09:38 Pat and Grace, 09:40 Bank alone, 09:42 the cash]

UNIDENTIFIED - flagged, not guessed. A hard overhead of a public stairway: a woman in a pink dress lying across the steps, a student in white uniform crouched over her, other figures moving in and out of frame, a bag spilled on the landing. Read at 0.75s across the whole window and it still does not resolve into an event I can name, and it does not match the gate assault at 00:57:46 (different location, daylight, different clothing). Do NOT bind a narration line to this shot without settling what it is [dense 0.75s at 01:09:52: fifteen frames, 09:45-09:58]

Pat alone at the interview table. He starts the answer laughing, and somewhere in the middle of it his hands go up over his face and stay there [grid 2s: 10:12/10:14 laughing, 10:16/10:18 both hands over the face, 10:20/10:22 doubled over the table]
He keeps going and cannot get through it - talking with his hands folded, then covering his eyes again [grid 2s: 10:24 through 10:34, six frames, the same held front-on framing]

Pat at the interview table, front-on and lit, talking - this is the shot the reveal is SPOKEN in, and it sits after the 01:10:40 landing [grid 2s: 10:48/10:50/10:52, mouth open in all three, Lynn's striped sleeve across the foreground]
The print shop side of the intercut: Grace against the wall with her hands at her chin, Lynn at the table, Bank standing off in blue - nobody moving [grid 2s: 10:54/10:56, one framing]
